findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-memory-utils" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kv_put, kv_get, kv_list, util_uuid, util_hash, util_ip, util_jwt_decode, util_json_validate, util_base64, time, random, x402_test_purchase, x402_ping, x402_echo · Private data: kv_put, kv_list, util_json_validate, x402_test_purchase · Public sink: kv_put.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kv_put, kv_get, kv_list, util_uuid, util_hash, util_ip, util_jwt_decode, util_json_validate, util_base64, time, random, x402_test_purchase, x402_ping, x402_echo · Private data: kv_put, kv_list, util_json_validate, x402_test_purchase · Public sink: kv_put

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
